Implementation Plan

Plan for `review-linked-issue-batching`

Planning ref: `bff7a8ae671ca64f0949109e7a0550945d17ef4d` on `orchestrator/project-3323`

Automation / wiring
- Change type: extend an existing script and its existing contract tests only.
- Existing entry point remains `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` via `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh`.
- No new workflow, scheduler wiring, supervisor, DB work, or `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` entry is needed.

1. Files likely to change
- `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh`
  - Keep the primary `closingIssuesReferences` GraphQL fetch intact.
  - Replace only the fallback `while ... gh api "repos/${REPOSITORY}/issues/${_fb_num}"` loop in the linked-issue context path.
- `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`
  - Update the fallback-path contract tests and add one cap/batching-focused case.

2. Functions or modules to implement
- In `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh`, add a small local batched-fallback helper or inline block that:
  - reads the already-computed `LINKED_ISSUE_FALLBACK_NUMBERS_JSON`
  - preserves the current `20`-issue cap before querying
  - builds one aliased `gh api graphql` query over the fallback numbers
  - requests only the fields needed to preserve the current context format (`number`, `title`, `body`; optionally `__typename` for union handling)
  - transforms the GraphQL response back into the same array-of-objects shape the existing Python serializer already consumes
- Use the existing alias-per-number pattern from `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` as the representative batching implementation to mirror.
- For REST parity, prefer `repository.issueOrPullRequest(number: N)` over `issue(number: N)`, since GitHub documents `issueOrPullRequest` as returning an issue-like object and the union can be either `Issue` or `PullRequest`. `closingIssuesReferences` should remain the first/primary path. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud%40latest/graphql/reference/repos))

3. Data structures affected
- `LINKED_ISSUE_FALLBACK_NUMBERS_JSON`
  - stays a JSON array of strict PR-title/PR-body fallback numbers.
- `_linked_context_raw`
  - fallback source changes from per-issue REST responses to one GraphQL batch result.
- `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON`
  - must remain numbers-only and continue to reflect only the primary linked-issue fetch contract.
- `LINKED_ISSUE_CONTEXT_FILE`
  - format must remain unchanged (`Issue #<n>: <title>` plus body text).

4. API or interface changes
- No external interface change to workflows, env vars, or downstream prompt files.
- Internal transport change only:
  - keep the existing primary `pullRequest(number: $number) { closingIssuesReferences(first: 50) { ... } }`
  - replace fallback REST `GET /repos/{repo}/issues/{n}` calls with one GraphQL alias batch
- GitHub documents `closingIssuesReferences` as the list of issues a PR may close, and closing-keyword links are only created when the PR targets the default branch, which matches why this fallback exists for non-default-base PRs. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-server%403.20/graphql/reference/pulls))

5. Potential risks or edge cases
- Preserve the current `20`-issue cap exactly.
- Keep fail-open behavior:
  - if fallback batch fetch fails, do not exit
  - leave `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON` untouched
  - leave linked-issue context empty/default and warn
- Skip null/malformed per-alias entries rather than failing the whole fallback payload.
- Important parity risk: GraphQL `issue(number:)` is issue-only, while the current REST `/issues/{n}` path can surface PR-backed issue records too; `issueOrPullRequest` avoids that regression. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud%40latest/graphql/reference/repos))
- No factual conflict found: the described per-issue REST fallback loop is present in the current code.

6. Testing considerations
- Update existing fallback contract cases in `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py` so they:
  - still assert unchanged linked-issue context content
  - still assert `LINKED_ISSUES_JSON == "[]"`
  - stop expecting per-issue REST fallback calls
  - instead assert that a second GraphQL call was issued and that its query includes aliased fallback numbers
- Add one focused test for the `>20` fallback-number case to confirm the cap still limits the batch to 20 numbers.
- Run the targeted helper contract suite for `tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py`.

Assumptions
- Scope stays limited to `scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh` and its contract tests.
- No shared helper extraction or unrelated API-hygiene cleanup is part of this issue.
